role: RecordPanels extension holding the Record tab's overnight 'Extended Recording' panel (capture mode picker, status badge/subtitles, paused/streaming/legacy/idle button sets, battery and connection notes), the Continue Recovery card, device-data recovery/discard actions, and the Quick Reading panel; plus three file-private continue-recovery helpers.
types: RecordPanels: extension — panel view builders and recovery actions (RecordPanels struct declared in RecordPanels.swift:16, rebuilt per access by RecordView.panels)
RecordPanels.QuickReadingButton: struct (View, private) — duration tile button for 2/3/5-minute readings
toplevel: File-scope @MainActor private helpers continueRecoveryHeader/Title/ScoreLine (lines 827-869) used by continueRecoveryCard.

units.does: Extended Recording card: header, capture-mode picker (only when not actively recording and no fetch in progress), streaming status, device-recording status, fetch progress, action buttons and hint text.

branches.effect: true: capture-mode picker shown; false: hidden

units.does: Two hint lines ('Start before bed…', 'Analysis uses the strongest recovery window…') when idle: not recording on device, not overnight streaming, recordingState .idle, no fetch progress.
FetchProgressCard with device name and a Cancel that cancels the Polar transfer, whenever fetchProgress is set.
DeviceRecordingStatus with persisted recording start time when recording on device, not overnight streaming and no fetch in progress.

branches.effect: true: status view (start time nil if no persisted state); false: nothing

units.does: OvernightStreamingStatus (lifecycle, PolarManager, strap backup state, collector.sessionStartTime for wall-clock elapsed) while overnight streaming.
Strap backup state for the status card: .notRequested when the backup is off or a Verity Sense is connected, else .recording once the H10 backup is active, else .starting.
Header: 'Extended Recording' title, mode subtitle and status badge.
Capture modes for the picker: [streaming, internalCapture] for a Verity Sense, all three otherwise.
Capture mode block: title row with Make Default, segmented picker, and help text.
Segmented Picker bound to extendedCaptureMode over availableCaptureModes, labelled by mode.title.
'Capture Mode' label with the Make Default button on the right.
When the current mode differs from settings.defaultCaptureMode, shows 'Make Default' which stores the mode's rawValue as the default (saved to user_settings.json by SettingsManager).
Capsule badge with a red dot while overnight streaming, recording on device or recordingState .recording, plus recordingStatusText; accessibility label 'Status: …'.
Status text: 'Streaming overnight' when streaming, else per recordingState.
Subtitle: live-stream text while streaming, device-memory text while recording on device, else a description of the selected capture mode.

branches.effect: 'Record directly on device memory (no live stream)'

units.does: Help text for the selected capture mode, with a Verity-specific streaming text.

branches.effect: Verity → 'cannot run internal at same time'; otherwise 'skips strap memory fetch'
true: Verity text; false: H10 streaming text
'Maximum recovery reliability' text (never shown for Verity since .both is coerced away)

units.does: Chooses the action button set: paused, overnight streaming (no morning status), device/legacy recording, or idle; plus a spinner while an action is in flight.

branches.effect: true: streamingStateButtons. The morningStatus == nil half is always true when this renders: the panel is reached only through activeSessionSection, which requires morningStatus == nil (RecordView+Sections.swift:121)
true: legacyRecordingButtons; false: idleStateButtons. Not shown during morning processing: the whole panel is hidden then (RecordView+Sections.swift:121)

units.does: Paused set: paused score preview, Resume button, 'Reconnect device to resume' when not connected, and Done.
'Done' button finishing the paused session via the finalizeFromPause closure.
'Resume Recording' button (disabled unless connected) calling the resumeRecording closure.
Overnight-streaming set: connection/battery warning, I'm Up, and 'Pause & Resume Later' (pauseRecording closure, disabled while busy).
'I'm Up' button calling stopAndFetch (disabled while busy).
Connection-lost banner when PolarManager reports a stalled feed or the device is disconnected, else stale-battery banner when the battery reading is stale.
Red banner 'Device connection lost' saying data up to the disconnect is saved and to tap I'm Up.
Warning banner 'Battery reading may be outdated'.
'Wake Up - Get Results' button for device/internal recording calling stopAndFetch.
'Start Extended Recording' button (disabled while busy, when not connected or battery <10%) calling startOvernightRecording, followed by the idle note.
Single most-urgent note under Start: connect prompt, critical battery, strap-may-refuse, low battery, or unrecovered data.
Caption 'Connect to Polar device first'.
Red 'Battery too low to record' with 'Charge your device above 10% before starting'.
True when the mode arms the strap's own memory (not .streaming) and StrapRecordingPolicy says the H10 battery (≤20%) may refuse to record.
Warning that the strap at N% may refuse to record to its memory and to replace the CR2025.

branches.effect: 0 shown if level nil; unreachable in practice since strapMayRefuseToRecord requires a non-nil level

units.does: Warning 'Battery is low (N%) — recording may not last all night'.

branches.effect: 0% shown when nil (isBatteryLow requires non-nil, so not reached)

units.does: Orange 'Unrecovered data on device' note asking to recover or discard first.
Bordered card: paused header, metric cards from the paused session, and 'Your data is saved'.
Green shield 'Your data is saved' row.
Metric preview cards for the paused session's analysis result if both exist.
Pause icon with paused header text.
'Recording Paused' plus 'Paused <relative> ago' when pausedDate is known.

branches.effect: true: relative time line; false: none

units.does: Continue Recovery card: header, recovery-so-far line, Continue Recording button, and 'Connect device to resume' when disconnected.
'Continue Recording' button (disabled unless connected) calling startLinkedRecording(session).
True while recordingState is starting/stopping/fetching.
Starts a Task running performDeviceRecovery.

Inside RecordingKeepAwake.during (screen kept on when opted in), calls collector.recoverFromDevice; on error hands it to surfaceRecoveryError so the error alert shows, and leaves fetchFailed alone so the Recover card (shown with no session type selected) stays available to try again.
Sets sessionState.lastError to the Recover error unless the collector already recorded one (refusal or failed download); a recording too short to assemble only throws, so this raises its alert.

branches.effect: false: keep the recorded reason; true: lastError = error

units.does: Task: deletes stored exercises on the strap; failure is logged and assigned to sessionState.lastError (alert).

branches.effect: logs and sets lastError so the error alert shows; success gives no UI feedback beyond the strap state refreshing

units.does: Quick Reading card: header, then live streaming progress during quick streaming, or the duration options when idle.
StreamingProgressPanel with collector, lifecycle, PolarManager, breathing audio and stopStreaming closure.
Explanatory caption plus buttons or battery warning.
Battery-too-low note when critical, else the duration choices.
Red 'Battery too low — charge above 10%'.
Button row plus optional low-battery warning.
'Battery is low (N%)' when isBatteryLow.

branches.effect: 0 when nil (unreached: isBatteryLow needs a level)

units.does: HStack of 2, 3, 5 minute buttons.
5 min 'Full' button → startStreaming(300).
3 min 'Standard' button → startStreaming(180).
2 min 'Basic' button → startStreaming(120).
Header row: title text and Live badge.
'Quick Reading' title with 'Spot check - keep app open during recording'.
Green 'Live' capsule while streaming.
Plain button running the action closure with combined accessibility label '<duration> quick reading'.
Tile with icon, duration and description, bordered in the button colour.
Header row for the continue-recovery card: rotate icon plus title.
'Continue Recovery' plus 'Last segment ended <relative> ago' when endDate is set.
When the paused session has a recoveryScore (0–10), shows 'Recovery so far: N' (score×10, clamped/rounded 0–100) coloured by recovery band, with a re-score note.
